description: Evaluates safe stencil binding expressions. The grammar is deliberately tiny: literals, bare identifiers that read the element's props, the built-ins size.w, size.h and repeat.index, arithmetic and comparison operators, ?? and ternary conditionals, and the single permitted function token(key, fallback). Any other call is a parse error. The public evaluation APIs never throw — an unparseable or nonsensical expression yields StencilValue.Null — so a broken stencil pack cannot take the editor down.
